metadata.title: Project Repository Setup and Developer Environment

story.iWant: establish a standardized GitHub repository structure with build tooling configuration
story.soThat: all developers have a consistent starting point and can quickly run local builds
story.tasks: - Create genapp-backend/ subfolder and initial folder structure (AC: #1) - Configure Maven pom.xml with Spring Boot 3.3+ (AC: #2) - Configure .gitignore in genapp-backend/ (AC: #3) - Write comprehensive README.md in genapp-backend/ (AC: #4) - Configure Git workflow and protection rules (AC: #6) - Configure Checkstyle and SpotBugs for code quality in genapp-backend/ (AC: #7) - Configure pre-commit hooks (AC: #8) - Verify local build and run (AC: #5)

acceptanceCriteria.criterion: genapp-backend/ subfolder created with clear folder structure (src/, tests/, config/, helm/)
Maven pom.xml configured in genapp-backend/ with Spring Boot 3.3+ LTS, all required dependencies (Spring Web, Data JPA, Security, Cloud Gateway, Actuator, etc.)
.gitignore configured in genapp-backend/ for Maven/IntelliJ/VS Code/Docker artifacts
README.md created in genapp-backend/ with developer setup instructions (Java 17+, Maven 3.8+, Docker, PostgreSQL, mvn clean install)
Local development can run from genapp-backend/: mvn clean install && mvn spring-boot:run -Dspring-boot.run.arguments="--spring.profiles.active=dev"
Git workflow documentation updated in root repository (branch naming: feature/*, bugfix/*, main is protected, PR process)
Java code style configuration (Google Style Guide via Checkstyle, SpotBugs) integrated into genapp-backend/ build
Pre-commit hooks configured to prevent unformatted code commits in genapp-backend/

artifact.reason: This story creates the genapp-backend/ directory structure - primary deliverable
Root-level CI/CD pipelines will orchestrate genapp-backend builds

constraints.constraint: Repository uses GitHub with branch protection rules on main
Java 17+ LTS required for Spring Boot 3.3+ compatibility
Maven 3.8+ required for security improvements and dependency resolution
Project structure must support monorepo with multiple subfolders (genapp-backend, genapp-frontend, base/)
Code style follows Google Java Style Guide via Checkstyle integration
Pre-commit hooks must prevent unformatted code from being committed
Local build must complete with: mvn clean install && mvn spring-boot:run
All configuration files (.gitignore, pom.xml, README.md) must be in genapp-backend/ root
Build process must include code quality checks (Checkstyle, SpotBugs)

interface.name: Git Workflow
interface.signature: Branch naming: feature/*, bugfix/*, hotfix/*; main branch protected; PR required for merge

tests.standards: Unit tests use JUnit 5 with Mockito for mocking. Integration tests use TestContainers for database testing. API tests use MockMvc for controller testing. Minimum 80% code coverage target. All tests must pass before code can be committed (enforced via pre-commit hooks).

ideas.idea: Verify genapp-backend/ directory structure matches specification: src/, tests/, config/, helm/ subdirectories exist
Unit test Maven pom.xml parsing and Spring Boot configuration; verify all dependencies present with correct versions
Integration test: mvn clean install succeeds with all plugins executing
Verify .gitignore patterns correctly exclude Maven, IDE, Docker, and OS artifacts
Verify README.md contains all required sections: project overview, prerequisites, setup steps, development profiles, troubleshooting
Integration test: mvn spring-boot:run with dev profile starts application on port 8080 and responds to health check
Verify WORKFLOW.md documents branch naming conventions, PR process, and protection rules
Unit test: Checkstyle and SpotBugs plugins execute during build and fail on violations
Verify pre-commit hook script exists, is executable, and correctly intercepts unformatted commits
